neighbours.label: the less-than operator ' <' in a code comparison (an upper bound on a value); English 'less than' or 'under' does not carry it
fire:
items = load()
small = [v for v in items if v < 10]
quiet:
items = load()
large = [v for v in items if v > 10]

predictions: fire 0.5-0.9 on ' <' in code comparisons; the same code with ' >' or '==' below 0.08
notes: Card: peaks on code ' <' (x7), 'than' after 'less', 'under' the age. Probe: 'if x >= 0 and x < 10' 0.772, 'at most one hundred, or' 0.176; English 'under the age' 0.017, 'less than five degrees' 0.009, 'below the threshold' 0.035, same code with ' >' 0.038. The test is therefore restricted to code.
